g.text: Unconditional income didn't reduce work — Stockton SEED

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: Stockton, California, SEED programme: 125 residents received $500/month with no work requirement, 2019–2021.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: Full-time employment among recipients rose 28% to 40% in the first year, against 32% to 37% in the randomised control

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: group — a gain more than twice the control's. Source: Stockton Economic Empowerment Demonstration, stocktondemonstration.org.
